title: Six to Ten, and One Sound Law
label: ch:fa-count-ten
canDo: I can say, hear and recognise every Persian number from one to ten, write the two of them made only of letters I have been taught, and explain why haft begins with h where septem begins with s.

payoff.summary: Five more numbers, the Iranian s-to-h rule that explains one of them, the analogy that explains the next, and the whole run of ten shuffled.
